content.text:
Trump and Xi to Discuss Trade at APEC Summit. What Isn’t Said May Matter More.
Jazz legend Miles Davis reportedly described his musical genius as the ability to “play what’s not there,” an assessment experts use to underscore the importance of both the notes and the silence between them.
